cats.name: Portraits
cats.description: Headshots, editorial portraits and personal shoots. People as they are, around Ljubljana and wherever the story takes us.
cats.description_sl: Poslovni in editorial portreti ter osebna fotografiranja. Ljudje takšni, kot so, po Ljubljani in povsod, kamor nas pelje zgodba.

cats.name: Automotive
cats.what: Rollers, statics, car meets and events
cats.what_sl: Posnetki v vožnji, statični posnetki, srečanja in dogodki
cats.description: Cars in motion and at rest: rolling shots, statics, details and car meets, on stills and on video.
cats.description_sl: Avtomobili v gibanju in mirovanju: posnetki v vožnji, statični posnetki, detajli in srečanja, na fotografijah in v videu.

cats.name: Street photography
cats.what: Streets and moments of the world.
cats.description: Everyday moments and brand content. Real people in real places, made for social media and campaigns.
cats.description_sl: Vsakdanji trenutki in vsebina za znamke. Resnični ljudje na resničnih krajih, za družbena omrežja in kampanje.

cats.name: Sports
cats.description: Action, teams and match days. Peak moments and the energy around the game.
cats.description_sl: Akcija, ekipe in tekmovalni dnevi. Vrhunski trenutki in energija okoli igre.

cats.name: Film
cats.description: Short films, reels and edits, from planning the shots to the final cut.
cats.description_sl: Kratki filmi, videi in montaže, od načrtovanja posnetkov do končne montaže.
